name: tor
description: An older man in his sixties, a carpenter. A gentle, soft, slow voice, patient and warm, with a craftsman's calm.
reference_text: Measure twice, cut once. My father said that every morning, and I never listened. Now look at me, eighty planks and not one of them crooked. Could you hold this end? Mind your fingers! Good. A roof is only a promise, but it's a good one to keep.
